title: USA Rare Earth, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR) filed an 8-K announcing entry into a definitive Merger Agreement dated April 19, 2026, with SVRE Holdings Ltd. and Serra Verde Rare Earths Ltd. for a business combination transaction. The filing includes standard boilerplate language about the merger agreement terms and forward-looking statements.
key_points: USAR announced entry into a Merger Agreement dated April 19, 2026 with SVRE Holdings Ltd. and Serra Verde Rare Earths Ltd.
Merger Sub (Middlebury Merger Sub Ltd., BVI-incorporated) is a wholly owned subsidiary of USAR.
The transaction includes a Form Voting Agreement and Form Registration Rights Agreement as exhibits.
USAR is an emerging growth company as defined by Rule 405 of the Securities Act.
The company is listed on Nasdaq under ticker USAR.
The filing incorporates by reference a previous 8-K filed the same day describing material terms.
